summary_en: 4,039,700 ordinary shares cancelled on 30 Jun 2026, representing 6.9% of pre-cancellation shares outstanding. Post-cancellation issued shares: 54,898,510. Shares were acquired under board-authorized program (13 May 2025) capped at 6M shares and ¥15.0B via open-market purchase, 14 May 2025–13 May 2026.
title_en: Notice of Completion of Treasury Share Cancellation
translation_en_brief: Glory Ltd. completed the cancellation of 4,039,700 treasury shares on 30 June 2026 pursuant to the Companies Act Article 178. These shares were ordinary shares acquired under a board resolution dated 13 May 2025, which authorized acquisition of up to 6.0 million shares for a maximum of ¥15.0 billion via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between 14 May 2025 and 13 May 2026. The cancelled shares represent 6.9% of the issued shares outstanding prior to cancellation. As of the cancellation date, the company's issued share count (excluding treasury) stands at 54,898,510 shares.
